content:
carla_support: @here escalating a customer report — Eliza (customer) says after an automatic regional failover their app started returning lower-quality answers and weird tokenization. Ticket 9227.

eliza_customer: pasted sample: 
```
Input: Summarize the quarterly sales by region.
Response: 
Summary: sales up 3%...
[TRUNCATED] strange tokens like \u0001 present and missing bullets. Model also produced wrong fiscal quarter numbers.
```

carla_support: They say they never changed model settings. Started around 2026-11-03 15:30 UTC when we had a regional outage in us-east and traffic failed over to eu-west. Symptoms: capability gap (smaller variant) and tokenizer artifacts. Also customer saw spike in token usage due to retries.

ben_sre: I'll check routing logs. @infra_bot can you surface the failover events for customer_id=eliza-co between 1848120200-1848124000?

infra_bot: [automated] Failover events for eliza-co: 1848123401 -> routed to eu-west-2; fallback model selected: redwood-1b-quant-v2 (compatible=False), previous pinned model: redwood-3b-fp16-v1 (compatible=True).

dan_runtime: That explains capability gap — the runtime picked a quantized 1B variant during capacity shortage. Tokenizer differences come from model family mismatch (3b uses BPE-v3, 1b uses legacy BPE-v1). We should have prevented cross-family substitution.

maya_product: Customer report also mentions auth flicker then retries — could be why route policy downgraded? Any rate limit or quota errors?

ben_sre: Checked auth logs: no 401s. There were transient 429 spikes from a downstream proxy which triggered the retry/backoff and then our smart routing moved traffic to available capacity in eu-west where only the smaller variant was free.

dan_runtime: Repro steps I'm running locally:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" -H \"X-Region: us-east-1\" -d '{"model":"redwood-3b-fp16-v1","input":"Summarize X"}'
2) Simulate us-east outage (iptables drop) and re-run same request; observe routing policy picks eu-west and we map to redwood-1b-quant-v2.

carla_support: Eliza provided an original good output and a bad output. Attaching inline:
Good (before failover): 
- accurate quarters, proper lists, no token artifacts.
Bad (after failover): 
- hallucinated values, weird control characters, truncated bullets.

eliza_customer: This broke a live dashboard. We need either rollback to the previous model or a quick compatibility check so fallback doesn't swap families. Also we noticed billing spike. Please advise immediate mitigation.

dan_runtime: Short-term mitigation: force-route eliza-co to reserved capacity in us-east (we have empty dedicated slots) and map requests to their pinned model id. I'll run a manual route override. ETA 10m.

ben_sre: Also rolling a patch to add a compatibility predicate to routing: require tokenizer_hash and model_family match for fallback options. Will test in staging then hotfix to prod.

maya_product: Communicate to customer: acknowledge impact, explain cause (regional failover -> smaller incompatible fallback), provide remediation steps and credit for excess tokens due to retries.

carla_support: Message draft: \"Sorry about the disruption — we incorrectly routed traffic to an incompatible smaller variant during regional failover. We're restoring your pinned model and issuing credits for extra token usage. Our engineering team will add compatibility checks to prevent this. ETA for full fix: 48 hours.\" Thoughts?

eliza_customer: That sounds good. Can you also provide a short-term API header they can use to pin traffic to a region until you fix routing?

dan_runtime: Yes: use header `X-Redwood-Region: us-east-1` and `X-Model-Enforce: strict` (temporary internal flag). We'll document but mark as internal for now.

ben_sre: Post-incident actions:
- incident ticket and RCA (owner: dan_runtime)
- add automated test asserting fallback candidates share tokenizer_hash (owner: eng-ml)
- billing adjustment workflow for affected customers (owner: finance ops)
- add visibility in console showing when a fallback variant differs in model_family (owner: console team)

carla_support: I'll send the customer update and create the internal incident. Anyone want to add reproduction artifacts or logs?

dan_runtime: I'll upload gateway logs and the runtime decision trace to the incident ticket. Key snippet shows selected_variant != pinned_variant and tokenizer_hash mismatch.

ben_sre: I'll follow up on the proxy 429 source so we can avoid unnecessary failovers.

carla_support: Thanks everyone. Eliza, we'll confirm once the manual route override is complete and send credits. :thumbsup:

eliza_customer: Thanks — appreciate the quick response.

carla_support: (after 10m) manual override applied, traffic back to us-east and pinned model. Please validate output and let us know.

eliza_customer: Confirmed — outputs restored to previous quality. No weird tokens. Dashboard back to normal.

carla_support: Closing loop, will add RCA link once ready.
